$comment: Every dependency advisory this project knowingly accepts. Enforced by
- any advisory NOT listed here fails the build, at any severity
- every entry needs ghsa, package, owner and reviewBy
- reviewBy in the past fails the build (the exception has expired)
- an entry whose advisory has been fixed upstream is reported so it can be deleted
pnpm 9.15 cannot express these exclusions itself: auditConfig.ignoreCves
matches on CVE ids and this advisory is GHSA-only with no CVE.
This file is the reviewable, expiring record instead of a silent --ignore flag.

exceptions.title: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections
exceptions.chain: zod@3.25.76, a direct dependency of @markus/config and @markus/llm-gateway (declared but unused in @markus/core)
exceptions.runtimeExposure: No untrusted oversized arrays reach a zod array schema. @markus/config parses operator-controlled environment variables once at process boot - a hostile value kills the process it was fed to, which is not a remotely triggerable denial of service. @markus/llm-gateway validates responses from the first-party configured LLM provider over authenticated TLS (DashScope/OpenAI-compatible); the parsed arrays (choices, embeddings) are bounded by the provider protocol, and exploitation would require a compromised provider endpoint. The exploit primitive (unbounded issue accumulation in array parsing) needs attacker-controlled array lengths, which neither consumer exposes.
exceptions.reason: No fixed release exists on the zod 3 line: the advisory (CVE-2023-54404) is patched only in 4.6.6 and v3 remains vulnerable. Migrating to zod 4 is a breaking change across the env schema and gateway response schemas and is scheduled as its own backlog item rather than bundled into P2.1.
exceptions.exploitability: An attacker must either control the operator's environment (already game over) or the TLS-authenticated LLM provider endpoint. No user request input flows into a zod array schema: the API validates request bodies with hand-rolled strict validators (apps/api/src/auth/routes.ts).
exceptions.revisitWhen: zod 4.6.6 migration lands on the P-track backlog
